findings.title: G7 model-output stage parser accepted malformed nested V/L/U fields
findings.evidence: Before the repair, normalize_stages accepted a V object containing ground_truth, L nodes containing objects, L edges with non-string endpoints, U node_changes containing private extra fields, and Q containing verifier_ref. A read-only scan of the immutable protocol-corrected states found 7 completed rows with Q missing reason, 3 with V verifier_ref, 2 with L verifier_ref, 8 with U eligibility/provenance fields, and 1 invalid U node change. Historical raw states are preserved and not reclassified.
findings.remediation: Require exact public V/L/U/Q nested schemas in normalize_stages and retain malformed provider outputs as failed attempts with bounded format retry; extend the forensic taxonomy to report verifier_ref/eligibility metadata hits. Never repair historical rows in place.
